COM_case_assumptions: Suspension axes pass through the lower-contact midpoints in fixture_geometry.json; roll front / pitch left side selection is inferred from pose and free-hanging stability.
COM is 25 mm below the FC, with the approximate CAD FC reference and provisional CAD height registration.
Body-frame products of inertia at the estimated COM are zero. Three scalar measurements cannot identify six independent tensor entries.
The provided mass is used as total suspended mass when supplied; no unprovided marker, fixture or attachment masses are subtracted.
Zero products are assumed at COM. Reference-origin values are derived by a parallel-axis shift of that tensor; off-diagonal entries at the reference origin are not generally zero.

adopted_reference.selected_reference: CAD FC position minus25mm along drone body Z
adopted_reference.body_frame: X forward, Y left, Z up; body reference origin at mean of M3–M6
adopted_reference.operator_decision: Use the COM from the CAD FC offset as the final working inertia reference.
adopted_reference.underlying_accuracy_status: CAD-based adopted reference; suspension-axis placement, attachments and uncertainty remain uncalibrated.
adopted_reference.freeze_policy: The adopted COM is frozen here. Regenerating or adjusting a visual preview must not change the adopted numerical model.
accuracy_inputs_still_missing: Confirmation of inferred front roll / left pitch contact edges, and independently measured upper-anchor positions and individual loaded string lengths
